info.name: Alteryx Server API V3 Collections API

description.content:
The Alteryx Server API V3 provides administrative capabilities for managing workflows, schedules, users, user groups, credentials, collections, and server connections. It uses OAuth 2 authentication and implements POST, PUT, GET, DELETE, and PATCH operations so administrators can automate tasks and integrate Server with existing API automation tools.
